detailed_description:

The video preserves the premium anime character-illustration medium of <Subject 1> while adding concert-grade stage lighting, LED reflections, crisp tartan and cotton motion, bright metal highlights, and bold editorial motion graphics. Warm white, tartan red, matte black, silver, and restrained cream accents form the palette, while chain arcs, O-ring circles, LED bars, checker fragments, and layered concert-light sweeps define the motion language and fast-cut rhythm.

[Shot 1] The first frame begins mid-motion in an extreme close-up as <Subject 1> turns from a lowered side gaze toward camera while two fingers sweep one silver fringe away from her eye. A compact lateral Arc follows the turn; short hair tips bounce, the studded choker shifts, the central O-ring swings, and soft red stage light slides across her cheek. Her eyes sharpen from detached calm into a direct skeptical lock on the lens as faint audience glow and LED shimmer pulse behind her.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.100, continuing the same movement, <Subject 1> drops her hand toward the waist belt, hooks one hanging silver chain, and flicks it outward while shifting one shoulder like a performance cue. The chain path generates a thin tartan-red light curve with silver ring echoes that travel through the air and contract toward screen right. The camera Trucks with the hand and Tilts back toward her face as one corner of her mouth lifts into a mischievous half-smile; chain, skirt pleats, hair, and light trail peak together and hard-cut into Shot 3.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.200, hard cut to a bright warm-ivory field where oversized ultra-bold condensed sans-serif letters spelling "ACTIVE" slam inward from both sides and tighten until the word fills nearly ninety percent of the frame. A huge tartan-red circle expands behind the text while fine silver-and-black rings counter-rotate, and the assembled typography retains a slight forward push. A large off-center waist-up crop of <Subject 1>, occupying about fifty percent of frame, pushes in from the left as she turns one shoulder and lifts her chin; silver hair, choker, and chains remain in motion. Portions of "ACTIVE" remain behind her while a narrow black chain-like stroke crosses the foreground. Her shoulder turn triggers a second red-circle burst that expands to full-screen and wipes into Shot 4.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.200, the wipe reveals a pale gray field with several tartan-red horizontal bands rolling at different speeds. The dominant band progressively reveals one complete giant ultra-bold "MODE: ENGAGE", while secondary bands carry fragmented letterforms, checker marks, and speed streaks. <Subject 1> enters vertically as a moving full-body silhouette, taking one performance step onto a lit stage edge and swinging one arm outward as if hitting the beat. The gesture triggers the main red band to reverse direction; the primary text remains behind her while one thin silver foreground streak sweeps in front. The reversed band match-cuts into Shot 5.

[Shot 5] At 00:04.100, the band becomes a fast Whip Pan into a wide concert-stage reveal with a glossy black main platform, a short runway, LED wall panels, moving white spotlights, and deep red lighting accents. <Subject 1> is already striding forward on the runway with relaxed stage confidence; the tartan skirt reacts to each step, waist chains swing with delayed inertia, and her silver bob lifts subtly while audience-side light flares move across the reflective floor. The camera settles into a low Tracking Shot.

[Shot 6] At 00:05.200, a dynamic low medium-close shot begins on one chunky platform boot landing on the lit stage floor and Tilts upward across the thigh garter, tartan pleats, layered chains, teddy-bear graphic, off-shoulder neckline, and choker. <Subject 1> catches one side of her belt briefly, releases it, then turns her eyes toward camera. Her expression changes from cool confidence into a slightly raised-brow, mildly disdainful look, while a passing spotlight and blurred LED edge sweep through the foreground.

[Shot 7] At 00:06.200, hard cut to a bright tartan-red-and-cream split field where "SYSTEM" drops from above and "LINK" rises from below as two enormous ultra-bold condensed layers, locking into upper and lower text fields with a narrow center gap and continuing a slight opposing drift. A huge shoulder-and-face crop of <Subject 1>, occupying nearly sixty percent of the frame, fills the central layer as she turns from profile toward camera, blinks once, then sharply sends her gaze sideways. Silver hair and the black choker intersect the gap while a bright scan line sweeps across her eyes. Her gaze triggers a brief positive-negative split before the scan wipes into Shot 8.

[Shot 8] At 00:06.900, from a low three-quarter perspective, <Subject 1> performs a cool stage move: one quick side step, a hip pivot, and a sharp shoulder-led turn, letting the pleated tartan skirt flare while several silver chains swing late through the motion. The camera performs a compact fast Arc around her as white spotlights crisscross overhead and red LED strips flash behind. She finishes with her head turned back toward camera and a playful but controlled defiant expression.

[Shot 9] At 00:07.900, a warm-ivory field with tartan-red and charcoal diagonal planes appears as the giant ultra-bold "TARGET LOCK" moves from distant depth toward camera along a perspective-shortened diagonal. Front and rear text sections arrive deliberately offset before the final lock. An extreme diagonal crop of <Subject 1>'s eye, silver fringe, choker, and teddy-bear shirt edge travels through foreground depth, occupying about forty-five percent of frame while her pupils track rapidly along the incoming typography and her head follows slightly. The moment her gaze crosses the locking line, the words snap into alignment with a brief camera jolt and technical ticks; the nearest diagonal plane rushes past the lens and becomes Shot 10.

[Shot 10] At 00:08.600, the passing diagonal becomes a glowing stage-light edge along the runway. <Subject 1> approaches the lens, passes close beside it, then changes direction with a smooth half-turn and a confident runway-style step-back as the camera Trucks backward before swinging laterally. Her silver bob, skirt edge, chains, and wrist accessories trail through the turn with controlled blur, while moving beams sweep across the stage haze.

[Shot 11] At 00:09.600, cut to the only deep-black peak card as two gigantic offset lines of "FULL DRIVE" crash inward from top and bottom, overshoot, rebound into alignment, then surge toward the lens at different depths. <Subject 1> swings one forearm across her torso and steps forward into performance impact, tearing a broad tartan-red brush through the black field and revealing a dynamic half-body crop occupying roughly fifty-five percent of the frame. The principal typography stays behind her while enlarged cream letter edges, silver chain lines, and red brush remnants race through the foreground. Her expression becomes firm and fully focused as she pushes subtly closer; the nearest letter layer passes the lens and the brush collapses into a forward line that generates Shot 12.

[Shot 12] At 00:10.300, the forward line opens into the visual peak of the stage show: a wide hero angle on the main platform with LED walls blazing in abstract red-white checker pulses and spotlights converging behind her. <Subject 1> takes two confident strides, pivots one hip and shoulder, then plants one heavy boot forward and settles into a powerful asymmetric hero pose with one hand lifted near the collar line and the other relaxed by her side. The camera performs a short Pull Out combined with a subtle Arc as hair tips, tartan pleats, chains, bracelets, and shirt fabric continue moving before settling.

[Shot 13] At 00:12.300, hard cut to a clean warm-ivory identity layout where the giant display name "looova" first stretches almost edge to edge and remains fully readable for one beat. <Subject 1> then takes one short step into a complete full-body hero position in front of part of the name while the smaller title "REBEL CHARM" appears beneath. Behind her, a huge translucent tartan-red circle, thin silver technical arcs, sparse black nodes, checker fragments, stitched linework, and a dark circular emblem derived from the choker O-ring and teddy-bear silhouette create layered depth. The camera remains nearly Static while she gives one restrained blink and her short hair, hanging chains, skirt pleats, and shirt edge retain subtle natural motion.
